items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: A little reading I'd done, a little learning I got. I started at Dave, at Old Man Jackson.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. I wonder if you could tell us a little bit about the bass, what you, when did you learn to read? You say you started out without learning to read.
Yeah, I started out with faking, yeah. A little reading I'd done, a little learning I got. I started at Dave, at Old Man Jackson. Yeah.
Had anybody, uh, 34 years in there. Had anybody given you any lessons at all, even about playing the bass in New Orleans?
